facts.statement: Liu Yongfei discovered the remains of a stegosaurian in 2002.
facts.quote: In 2002, Liu Yongfei discovered the remains of a stegosaurian.

facts.statement: The generic name Jiangjunosaurus refers to the abandoned town of Jiangjunmiao.
facts.quote: The generic name refers to the abandoned town of Jiangjunmiao.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen IVPP V 14724 was found in the Shishugou Formation dating from the Oxfordian stage.
facts.quote: The holotype, IVPP V 14724, was found in a layer of the Shishugou Formation, dating from the Oxfordian.

facts.statement: The elements of the holotype were found in almost perfect articulation.
facts.quote: These elements were found in almost perfect articulation.

facts.statement: The holotype represents a subadult individual.
facts.quote: It represents a subadult individual.

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus was a herbivorous stegosaurian dinosaur from the Oxfordian-age (Upper Jurassic) Shishugou Formation of the Junggar Basin, Xinjiang, China.
facts.quote: Jiangjunosaurus is an extinct genus of herbivorous stegosaurian dinosaurs from the Oxfordian-age (Upper Jurassic) Shishugou Formation of the Junggar Basin, Xinjiang, China.

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus lived during the late Jurassic, approximately 162 to 156 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 162 y 156 millones de años, en el Oxfordiense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus was a medium-sized stegosaur reaching 6 to 7 meters in length and 2.5 metric tons in body mass.
facts.quote: Jiangjunosaurus was a medium-sized stegosaur, reaching 6-7 m in length and 2.5 MT in body mass.

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus is distinguished by symmetrical tooth crowns that are wider than tall, a rectangular profile on the spine of the axis vertebra, and large vein openings in the rear neck vertebrae.
facts.quote: The describers established three distinguishing traits: the crowns of the teeth are symmetrical and in side view wider than tall; the spine of the axis, the second neck vertebra, has a rectangular profile in side view, instead of a triangular one; and the rear neck vertebrae have large vein openings in their sides.

facts.statement: The predentary bone of Jiangjunosaurus has a deep and hooked chin.
facts.quote: The predentary, the bone core of the lower beak placed on the fronts of both lower jaws, has a deep and hooked "chin".

facts.statement: There is a gap between the predentary and the tooth row in Jiangjunosaurus equal to about four tooth positions.
facts.quote: Between the predentary and the tooth row a gap is present equal to about four tooth positions.

facts.statement: CAT scans revealed that the large openings in the rear neck vertebrae of Jiangjunosaurus were not connected to inner air spaces but probably served as vein channels.
facts.quote: CAT-scans of the Jiangjunosaurus fossils revealed that the openings are not connected to inner air spaces and thus probably served as vein channels.

facts.statement: Two neck plates have been preserved in Jiangjunosaurus, probably in their original position.
facts.quote: Two neck plates have been preserved, probably in their original position.

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus was placed in the family Stegosauridae in 2007.
facts.quote: Jiangjunosaurus was placed in the Stegosauridae in 2007.

facts.statement: The original describers concluded that Jiangjunosaurus had a basal position within the Stegosauridae.
facts.quote: The describers concluded that within the Stegosauridae it had a basal position.

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus belongs to the suborder Stegosauria.
facts.quote: infraordo: Stegosauria

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus belongs to the family Stegosauridae.
facts.quote: familia: Stegosauridae

facts.statement: The genus Jiangjunosaurus was described by Jia et al. in 2007.
facts.quote: genus_authority: Jia et al., 2007

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus was an armored dinosaur with plates measuring 6 meters in length, 1.5 meters in height, and weighing an estimated 1500 kilograms.
facts.quote: Jiangjunosaurus es un dinosaurio acorazado con placas, que medía 6 metros de largo, 1,5 de alto y se le estima un peso de 1500 kilogramos

facts.statement: Researchers identified three distinctive features: symmetrical tooth crowns that are wider than tall in side view, a rectangular profile for the axis (second neck vertebra) instead of triangular, and large vein openings on the sides of posterior cervical vertebrae.
facts.quote: Los descriptores establecieron tres rasgos distintivos: las coronas de los dientes son simétricas y en vista lateral más anchas que altas, el axis, la segunda vértebra del cuello, tiene un perfil rectangular en vista lateral, en lugar de uno triangular y las vértebras cervicales posteriores tienen grandes aberturas de venas en sus lados

facts.statement: The predentary bone at the front of the lower jaws has a deep, hook-shaped chin.
facts.quote: El predentario, el núcleo óseo del pico inferior colocado en los frentes de ambas mandíbulas inferiores, tiene una "barbilla" profunda y en forma de gancho

facts.statement: There is a gap between the predentary bone and the row of teeth approximately equal to the width of four tooth positions.
facts.quote: Entre la hilera predentaria y la fila de dientes, existe un espacio igual a aproximadamente cuatro posiciones de los dientes

facts.statement: A vertical plate extends upward from the rear of a bone shelf on the outside of the tooth row, obscuring the teeth in side view.
facts.quote: Desde la parte trasera de un estante de huesos en la parte exterior de la fila de dientes, una placa vertical se extiende hacia arriba ocultando esa fila en vista lateral

facts.statement: The front and back teeth completely lack vertical ridges.
facts.quote: Los dientes anteriores y posteriores carecen de ellos por completo

facts.statement: CT scans revealed that the large openings in the neck vertebrae are not connected to internal air spaces but are likely just channels for veins.
facts.quote: Las exploraciones TAC de los fósiles de Jiangjunosaurus revelaron que las aberturas no están conectadas a los espacios aéreos internos y, por lo tanto, probablemente solo se trata de conductos para las venas

facts.statement: Two neck plates have been preserved, likely in their original positions.
facts.quote: Se han conservado dos placas de cuello, probablemente en su posición original

facts.statement: The neck plates are roughly circular or diamond-shaped.
facts.quote: Las placas son de forma aproximadamente circular o en forma de diamante

facts.statement: Remains of a stegosaur were discovered in 2002 by Liu Yongfei.
facts.quote: En 2002, Liu Yongfei descubrió los restos de un estegosáurido

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus fossils were found in the Shishugou Formation in the Xinjiang Province of China.
facts.quote: Jiangjunosaurus fue encontrado en la formación Shishugou, en la Provincia de Xinjiang, en China

facts.statement: The species was described in 2007 by Jia, Forster, Xu, and Clark based on the front half of a subadult skeleton.
facts.quote: Conocido por un esqueleto de la mitad delantera de un ejemplar sub adulto fue descrito por Jia, Forster, Xu y Clark, 2007

facts.statement: The genus name honors the ancient desert city of Jiangjunmiao near the discovery site, where 'Jiangjun' means 'general' in Chinese and the city was named after a general's burial temple.
facts.quote: El nombre es dado por la antigua ciudad del desierto Jiangjunmiao, cercana a la zona del descubrimiento, Jiangjun, 將 軍, es "general" en chino y el nombre de la ciudad, el "templo del general", ha sido explicado se el lugar entierro de uno de ellos

facts.statement: The species name refers to the Junggar region where the fossils were found.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie se refiere a la procedencia de los Junggar

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, IVPP V 14724, was found in an Oxfordian-age layer of the Shishugou Formation.
facts.quote: El holotipo , IVPP V 14724, se encontró en una capa de la formación Shishugou, que data del Oxfordiano

facts.statement: The holotype includes the jaw, some posterior skull bones, eleven neck vertebrae, ribs, a scapula, a coracoid, and two neck plates.
facts.quote: Incluye la mandíbula, algunos huesos del cráneo posterior, once vértebras del cuello, costillas, una escápula, un coracoides y dos placas del cuello

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus lived during the Oxfordian stage, between 161.5 and 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Oxfordian to Oxfordian (161.5 to 154.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: Jiangjunosaurus was classified in the family Stegosauridae in 2007.
facts.quote: Jiangjunosaurus fue clasificado en la familia Stegosauridae en 2007

facts.statement: Researchers concluded that Jiangjunosaurus held a basal position within its family.
facts.quote: Los autores concluyeron que dentro de su familia tenía una posición basal

facts.statement: This basal classification was based on comparative anatomy rather than an exact cladistic analysis.
facts.quote: Esto no se basó en un análisis cladístico exacto, sino se usó el método de la anatomía comparativa

facts.statement: It is suggested that Jiangjunosaurus may have been prey for the dinosaur Sinraptor.
facts.quote: pudiendo haber sido un objeto de presa de Sinraptor

facts.statement: The axis, the second neck vertebra, has a unique rectangular profile in side view instead of the typical triangular shape.
facts.quote: El axis, la segunda vértebra del cuello, tiene un perfil rectangular en vista lateral, en lugar de uno triangular

facts.statement: Common vertical ridges on the teeth are present but weakly developed, and the front and back teeth lack them entirely.
facts.quote: Las crestas verticales habituales están presentes pero débilmente desarrolladas; Los dientes anteriores y posteriores carecen de ellos por completo
